verdict.rationale: Vanta's own API marketing and reference docs say the API can bulk-assign owners to resources, mark resources out of scope, offload employees in batches, and 'automate bulk actions.' However, the reference endpoints shown (create, add, update, delete, upload) all act on a single item. No batch endpoint, request schema, or UI or MCP bulk action is documented, so the depth of bulk support is unproven. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints with request formats, bulk actions in the UI or through the MCP server, limits on batch size beyond per-endpoint rate limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: bulk assign owners to resources or mark them out of scope, or offload employees in batches.
